findings.description: The KMS key used for the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact of a key compromise and weakens cryptographic hygiene for audit data.

No explicit policy is attached to the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy granting the entire account root (and therefore any IAM principal with permissive IAM policies) full control over the key, including the ability to decrypt audit log data or schedule the key for deletion.
